seg.other_seg_label: Asphalt mix and Concrete (combined reporting segment)
seg.notes: As originally reported in the FY2007 10-K Note 15 and Q4-07 release: after the 16-Nov-2007 Florida Rock acquisition Vulcan reported three segments (Aggregates; Asphalt mix and Concrete combined; Cement) with segment revenues shown NET of intersegment sales (agg 2,316.7, A&C 765.7, cement 7.7; intersegment not disclosed -> interseg fields null). Asphalt mix and Concrete are a single combined segment, so revenue/GP sit in other_seg_* (other_seg_dda 20.3 added key); asph_*/conc_* hold only volumes and prices. Cement GP reported as '-' (0.0). Prices are LEGACY Vulcan averages (exclude Florida Rock), freight-adjusted for aggregates incl. internal sales; volumes include Florida Rock post-closing. agg_tons incl. 12.0m internal tons; cement 0.142m tons. total_dda = 271.5 per 10-K segment table/CF; the Q4-07 release IS memo line showed 272.8 (used in its EBITDA reconciliation). No freight-to-remote-sites split disclosed for 2007. See seg_recast for the FY2008 10-K basis incl. intersegment.

seg_recast.other_seg_label: Asphalt mix and Concrete (combined reporting segment)
seg_recast.notes: FY2008 10-K Note 15 presentation (segment revenues incl. intersegment; total intersegment -138.1). Still three reportable segments (Asphalt mix and Concrete combined), not four. The Q4-08 release showed slightly different 2007 figures (Aggregates 2,445.5, intersegment -135.5).

ngaap.notes: EBITDA 981.9 per Q4-07 release Table F = EBIT (op earnings 714.4 + other expense -5.3 = 709.1) + DDA from continuing ops 272.8; i.e. continuing-ops basis. Check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda (271.5) = 968.4 does not equal 981.9 because Vulcan's EBITDA also adds back the discontinued-ops loss (12.2) and uses release DDA 272.8 (vs 271.5 in the 10-K). The Q4-08 release restated 2007 EBITDA to 980.6 (DDA 271.5). No Adjusted EBITDA published; adj_items null. 'As adjusted' EPS excludes the California real-estate gain, ECU earn-out gain and Florida Rock acquisition effects (0.13 transaction costs, 0.12 higher interest, 0.07 share dilution = 0.32). Pre-tax reconciliation in ebt_bridge_lines (added key). The Q4-08 release re-presented 2007 adjusted EPS as 4.41 (excluding only real-estate and ECU gains).

bs.notes: FY2007 10-K (Ex.13) balance sheet as originally reported. The Q4-07 condensed release differed slightly (goodwill 3,793.9, deferred tax assets 53.4, total assets 8,942.9, LTD 1,528.7, equity 3,760.3); the audited 10-K is used. Minority interest 0.4 was presented within total liabilities (pre-FAS 160) - shown in bs.nci but NOT added to total_equity (total_liabilities 5,176.8 already includes it). Intangibles were inside other assets (FY2008 10-K later split: other intangibles 121.9, other assets 222.6). All treasury shares (44.1m) were cancelled in 2007; 108,234k shares issued = outstanding (10-K cover: 108,373,595 at 15-Feb-2008). Later restated in FY2009 10-K (Note 20): retained earnings 2,109.7.
